observations: From the idle desktop screenshot alone, purpose is unmistakable: header 'Job queue' + 'ADMIN' chip, four count tiles (Failed 3, Running 3, Queued 0, Succeeded 2), stacked composition bar, and a jobs table — exactly the brief's admin queue page.

Primary action reads correctly as 'Retry all failed 3': it is the only tinted primary button, first in the toolbar, red to match the failure theme; metrics confirm primaryAction.text = 'Retry all failed\n0'.

What needs attention is unambiguous: the 'Failed 3' tile is the only red-outlined tile, failed rows sort to the top with red 'Failed' pills, red reason strings ('Upstream timeout after 30s', 'Worker ran out of memory at 1.8 GB'), and per-row Retry buttons — matching the brief's 'deal with failed jobs'.
All three answers checked out against the brief after reading the source (RANK = {failed:0,...} sorts failures first; retryAll is the sole .btn.primary).
Raw ratio: 4/4 inventory items graphical+text.

Job status per row: colored pill with a per-status SVG glyph (alert triangle for failed, spinning arc for running, check for succeeded, clock for queued) plus the text label — statusIcon() + LABEL map in source; visible in idle screenshot.
Job progress: a native <progress> bar per row plus a numeric '81%' text; metrics count 9 <progress> elements and each gets aria-label 'Progress N%'.

Queue-level counts: four icon+number tiles (tile gets 'has'/'is-zero' and per-status color classes), a stacked composition bar (role=img, aria-label 'N failed, N running...') with red/blue/green segments, and filter chips with live counts — three redundant graphical encodings of the same counts.

Failure reason: red text with an inline alert-triangle SVG in the Detail column ('Upstream timeout after 30s' with warn icon), repeated in the drawer's red 'Failure reason' box — inherently textual content given graphical severity coding.
Metrics: graphical total 83 on desktop (29 svg, 9 progress, 45 badge-heuristic elements), the visual channel clearly dominates.
Desktop viewportWords is 104 for a full dashboard (mobile 65); helperWords 0 and longLeafWords 0 — there is no explanatory prose anywhere on the idle page.
22 button labels average 1.36 words; the only label above 3 words is 'Retry all failed' + count chip '3' (counted as 4 by the harness).
The dialog sub-line 'Requeues 3 jobs. Each job restarts from the beginning.' is the longest sentence on the page and carries real information (restart-from-zero consequence), not narration.

Error banner text 'Network error — the queue server did not respond. Showing the last known state.' states cause and current data validity in two short clauses; nothing restates what the table already shows.

Sole borderline restatement: empty-state 'Queue is empty' followed by 'Nothing has been submitted yet.' — the second line mostly restates the heading, though it disambiguates from the filtered-empty case which gets 'No matching jobs' instead.

Terminology is otherwise rigorously consistent: Retry/Retrying/Retry again/Retry job/Retry all failed/Retry remaining all use the same verb; Cancel/Cancelling/Cancel job likewise; status words (Queued/Running/Succeeded/Failed) match the API enum everywhere including filters, tiles, pills, and drawer.

Copy matches behavior throughout, verified by the async checklist: 'Retrying' appears only while retryJob is genuinely pending (item 10), 'Live · updated just now' matches real ~2 s polling (item 8), and 'Cancelled by admin' comes from the actual server snapshot (item 4).

Issue 1: mixed verbs for one action — buttons say 'Retry' but the success toast says 'Requeued job_x' and the dialog summary says 'N of N requeued'; defensible (retry causes a requeue) but two names for the same operation.
Issue 2: the degraded-polling live text renders as 'Updates failing · last 12s ago' — 'last … ago' is grammatically off; should be 'last update 12s ago' or 'updated 12s ago'.
No filler, no marketing tone, no placeholder text found in any of the ~40 UI strings in the source.

The page is organized around the admin's actual task: failed rows sort to the top (RANK failed:0), the only primary button is 'Retry all failed' with a live count chip, and the Failed tile is the only outlined tile — triage-first, not a neutral data table.

It invents admin-specific affordances no template ships: a stall detector ('No progress 34s' warn chip when a running job's progress hasn't moved for 30 s), a bulk-retry dialog with per-job Waiting/Retrying/Requeued states, a running Stop button, and 'Retry remaining N' after partial failure.

Type and color serve the task: JetBrains Mono for job IDs and drawer title, red/blue/green/neutral consistently mapped to failed/running/queued/succeeded across tiles, stack bar, pills, progress bars, and filters.

The live-status indicator degrades honestly per state ('Live · updated just now' / 'Paused · updated 3s ago' / 'Updates failing · last …') with polling backoff — an on-call operator concern, not a template feature.

Template DNA that remains: dark dashboard with a four-stat-card row above a table, Inter font, and toast notifications are stock admin-dashboard vocabulary — but here each element is wired to task semantics rather than decoration.

f2Redundant: Empty-state body 'Nothing has been submitted yet.' largely restates its own heading 'Queue is empty' (borderline: it does distinguish the true-empty case from the filtered 'No matching jobs' case).
f3Issues: Inconsistent naming for the same action: buttons and dialog title use 'Retry' ('Retry', 'Retry 3 jobs', 'Retry all failed') while the success toast and completion summary use 'Requeued' / 'requeued' ('Requeued job_x', '3 of 3 requeued').
Awkward grammar in the degraded live indicator: 'Updates failing · last 12s ago' — 'last' plus 'ago' is malformed; the paused variant 'Paused · updated 12s ago' shows the correct form.
f4TaskDriven: Failed jobs sort to the top of the table (RANK map puts failed first), putting the brief's 'deal with failed jobs' work at the top of the scan path.

'Retry all failed' is the sole primary button, carries a live failure-count chip, and opens a confirmation dialog listing each job with per-job Waiting → Retrying → Requeued/error outcomes, a Stop button, and 'Retry remaining N' after partial failure.
Stall detection: a 'No progress 34s' warning chip appears on running jobs whose progress hasn't advanced in 30 s (STALL_MS), a genuinely operational signal.
Failed tile is the only red-outlined summary tile; zero-count tiles get an 'is-zero' dimmed treatment so attention tracks real problems.
Stacked queue-composition bar (role=img with a full aria-label) gives at-a-glance failed/running/queued/succeeded proportions.
JetBrains Mono for job IDs, ID click-through to a detail drawer with 'Tracked since / Last change / Progress moved' timestamps — debugging metadata for an admin, not consumer chrome.
Live-status indicator with three honest states (Live / Paused / Updates failing) plus exponential polling backoff and a 'Showing the last known state.' banner with 'Retry now'.
Filter segments carry live per-status counts and the search box is scoped to 'Job ID' only, matching what an admin actually looks up.
Dialog copy warns of the consequence: 'Each job restarts from the beginning.'
f4Template: Four stat-cards-above-a-table dark dashboard layout is stock admin-template structure.
Inter as the UI font is a default choice.
Corner toast notifications for action results are a generic dashboard pattern.
Skeleton-row loading shimmer is a standard template loading treatment.
